title: Simplifying tactile images with TactileView
summary: A webinar demonstrates how to use TactileView software with a screen reader to create tactile graphics, showcasing menu-driven design and built-in portals for accessible tactile images.
body:
A webinar demonstrates how to use TactileView software with a screen reader to create tactile graphics, showcasing menu-driven design and built-in portals for accessible tactile images.
